source.dataset: Hong Kong regional overview from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, 2021 release
source.kind: DSM including vegetation and buildings, not bare-earth DTM; contemporary topographic context, not a historical reconstruction
source.vertical_datum: EGM2008 (EPSG:3855); no vertical conversion applied; not HKPD
source.array_order: C row-major, row 0 north; cell center E=822000+(col+0.5)*30, N=846010-(row+0.5)*30

source.mask_method: Official co-registered Copernicus Water Body Mask, nearest-neighbour reprojected to exactly the elevation output grid; no elevation-threshold ocean inference

source.coordinate_usage: For scene use E-East0 as X, N0-N as Z and original DSM height as Y. Do not multiply height for visual effect.
limitations: No 0.5m CEDD corridor data is mixed into this product.
No HKPD/EGM2008 vertical datum alignment has been performed.
Water mask and coast represent source-era edited DSM, not 1970s shoreline.
30m cell centres and bilinear reprojection do not give 30m vertical accuracy; no individual location accuracy is guaranteed.
Lake/river cells have actual DSM water-surface heights and must not be replaced by zero-ocean.
